sloka: मूलपत्रफलैः सर्वा वर्तयिष्यथ नित्यदा ।स्त्रियः किम्पुरुषान्नाम भर्तऽन्समुपलप्स्यथ ।। ७.८८.२३ ॥
transliteration: mūlapatraphalaiḥ sarvā vartayiṣyatha nityadā ।striyaḥ kimpuruṣānnāma bharta'nsamupalapsyatha ।। 7.88.23 ॥

translations.english: All of you shall always sustain yourselves with roots, leaves, and fruits, and as women, you shall obtain husbands named Kimpurushas.
